title: G35-7 流体统一物理门裁决证据(ci/g35_fluids_smoke.py --gate 产)
description: G35-7 流体统一物理门 g35.wave7.fluids 的 smoke 裁决证据:① kernels_spv_valid(rurixc 现编 9 kernel = 6 新〔g35_hash_cellkey/g35_hash_clear/g35_hash_cellrange/g35_xpbd_density/g35_xpbd_apply/g35_xpbd_velocity〕+ 3 sort 消费面〔g35_sort_hist/g35_sort_spine/g35_sort_scatter,W1 冻结面消费不修改〕+ spirv-val 全绿 + 冻结消费面 sha256 快照在档)② neighbor_sets_bitexact(cell_key/sorted_keys/sorted_idx/cell_start/cell_end 五整数流 device↔host 逐帧 memcmp 零容差位级——邻居结构位级 ⇒ 27-cell 固定序邻居集位级;host grid↔朴素 O(n²) 邻居集相等单测互核在 cargo test 面)③ hash_cell_floor_semantics(cell = floor((p−origin)/cs) 逐轴负坐标向负无穷 + 越界 clamp 到边界 cell 语义见证:negative_floor_events ≥ 1 且 clamp_events ≥ 1〔dam-break 触地帧预测位置必越下界 = 夹具咬合〕且整数流位级——RFC-0049 §4.10 F14 / G35_CONTRACT v1.1 增补 fact)④ xpbd_parity_within_budget(pos_x/y/z、vel_x/y/z、ρ、λ 八 f32 流逐帧 max abs diff 聚合 p100 ≤ 冻结容差——milestones/g35/g35_budget.json g35.fluids.parity_p100 程序读禁手写:threshold = measured × 2.0 标定冻结,measured = 0 时 threshold = 0;缺条目时标定腿先跑程序写入)⑤ density_error_measured(device ρ 流密度误差 measured 登记:mean|ρ/ρ0−1| 与正约束违反 mean(max(ρ/ρ0−1,0)) 首/末帧;压缩夹具首帧正约束违反必 > 0 咬合;收敛方向性断言归 fluid.rs 单测,登记不设死值)⑥ determinism_double_run(同 seed 全链双跑 digest 位级一致;digest = pos/vel/ρ/λ/cell_key/sorted/cell 区间字节 sha256 逐帧链式)⑦ red_arm_effective(--red-arm rho0-tamper ρ0 ×1.05 篡改双跑 digest 必异——digest 判据对约束求解敏感性证明)⑧ frame_ms_measured(device 19 dispatch 链〔cellkey + sort 3-pass 9 + clear + cellrange + [density+apply]×3 + velocity〕逐帧墙钟均值 measured_local 诚实登记,含 run_compute 逐 dispatch 会话重建开销,非帧率对标)。MPM 评估窗不实现(G2P/P2G 散射需原子或图着色与确定性协议冲突待裁,RFC-0049 §4.10 既有登记引用,notes 承载)。results.trimmed_mean = f32 measured p100 镜像(ci/budget_eval.py 通用路 evidence_file 消费面)。三态:无 Vulkan loader/设备 → DEV_ENV_DEGRADE 退 0(不冒充 PASS,不落本证据);RURIX_REQUIRE_REAL=1 下降级翻硬 FAIL。

frozen_consumed_snapshot.description: 冻结消费面 sha256 快照(kernels/g35_sort_hist.rx / g35_sort_spine.rx / g35_sort_scatter.rx / particles/mod.rs / particles/primitives.rs——G35-7 消费不修改承诺在档,漂移守护基线)

cell_size.description: = SPH 平滑半径 h(冻结相等,RFC-0049 §4.10)

grid.description: v1 密集网格每轴 cell 数冻结(cell_id < 64³ = 262144 < 2^24 键域)

iter.description: XPBD 固定迭代冻结(禁自适应早停)

bitexact.description: 五整数流(cell_key/sorted_keys/sorted_idx/cell_start/cell_end)全帧 memcmp 零容差位级才许 true

threshold.description: = measured × 2.0 标定冻结(程序产禁手写;measured = 0 时 = 0 零容差零条目)

calibrated_this_run.description: true = 本次 --gate 标定腿程序写入 g35_budget;false = 既有冻结条目程序读

stream_max.description: 逐流 max abs diff(pos_x/y/z、vel_x/y/z、rho、lambda 八 f32 流)

trimmed_mean.description: = f32_parity.measured_p100 镜像(ci/budget_eval.py 通用路 doc.results.trimmed_mean 消费面;g35_budget evidence_file 指向本件)

negative_floor_events.description: 逐粒子逐轴 floor((p−origin)/cs) < 0 事件累计(host 登记语义;≥ 1 才许 fact PASS——负坐标向负无穷取整域见证)

clamp_events.description: 逐粒子逐轴 floor 越 [0,63] clamp 事件累计(≥ 1 才许 fact PASS——越界 clamp 到边界 cell 如实登记语义见证)

mean_abs_err_first.description: device ρ 流首帧 mean|ρ/ρ0−1|(measured 登记)

pos_constraint_first.description: 首帧正约束违反 mean(max(ρ/ρ0−1,0))——压缩夹具必 > 0(咬合前提)

pos_constraint_last.description: 末帧正约束违反(登记不设收敛死值;方向性断言归 fluid.rs 单测)

double_run_bitexact.description: 同 seed 全链双跑 digest 位级一致才许 true(digest = pos/vel/ρ/λ/cell_key/sorted/cell 区间字节 sha256 逐帧链式)

detected.description: ρ0 篡改(×1.05)双跑 digest 必异才许 true(digest 判据对约束求解敏感性证明)

probe_evidence.description: probe 真跑 evidence 件(绿臂/红臂/标定腿,.tmp 工作区路径登记)
